sloka: प्राणत्यागश्च वैदेह्या भवेदनभिभाषणे ।एष दोषो महान् हि स्यान्मम सीताभिभाषणे ।। ५.३०.३६।।।।
transliteration: prāṇatyāgaśca vaidehyā bhavedanabhibhāṣaṇe ।eṣa doṣo mahān hi syānmama sītābhibhāṣaṇe ।। 5.30.36।।।।

translations.english: "If I talk to Vaidehi it will be a great mistake on my part.If I do not speak to Vaidehi she may give up her life.
